peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 25.1% above its local comparables; 100 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (53.2): 4.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 54 of 108 similar developments with a figure (the same as 7). Context, not scored: resales in 100% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $1,126,500 ($2,213 psf, 419–592 sq ft; 9 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,656 psf (range $1,421–2,230); 33.6% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $284,000 more. 2-bedroom: median $1,890,000 ($2,405 psf, 678–807 sq ft; 14 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,019 psf (range $1,672–2,186); 19.1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $303,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $2,838,000 ($2,501 psf, 1,022–1,270 sq ft; 13 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,038 psf (range $1,751–2,090); 22.7% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $525,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: The first resale wave ended before the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity. First resale wave from May 2023 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 16 earlier resales do not start the wave.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Siglap MRT about 280 m, Marine Terrace MRT about 1,070 m; closer than 77 of 116 similar developments (the same as 3). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Ngee Ann Primary School about 1,050 m; more than 0 of 116 similar developments (the same as 13). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 330 m), more than 54 of 116 similar developments (the same as 26); nearest hawker centre East Coast Lagoon Food Village about 900 m; nearest park East Coast Park Area D about 220 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Vela Bay, 386 new sales, about 1,740 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 160 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 386 new sales and 477 resales (863 purchases); new sales were 44.7% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 477 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 75 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 477 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 514 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−7.2%). Planning-area private resales −7.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
